automation.title: News automation
automation.description: Webhook channels ingest article text, generate a video, and upload to YouTube (direct).
automation.detailSubtitle: Edit channel defaults, copy the webhook URL, and review run history.
automation.accessDenied: Only admins can access this page.
automation.dashboardDescription: Webhook run volume and failures for the selected period. Total channels counts all configured channels.
automation.statTotalChannelsHint: All channels in the system (enabled and disabled).
automation.statTotalRunsHint: Webhook runs started in this period.
automation.statFailedRunsHint: Runs that ended with status failed in this period.
automation.statFailureRateHint: Failed runs divided by total runs in this period.
automation.validationCustomDates: Enter valid from and to dates (YYYY-MM-DD).
automation.validationCustomOrder: From date must be on or before the to date.
automation.disableConfirm: Disable this channel? The webhook will stop accepting posts.
automation.disabledBanner: This channel is disabled. The webhook will not accept posts until you enable it again.
automation.fieldEnabledHint: Disable pauses the webhook without deleting your settings. You can turn it back on anytime from this page or the channel list.
automation.segmentationPromptPlaceholder: e.g. Prefer shorter segments for fast-paced news; keep the hook in segment 1.
automation.segmentationPromptHint: Applied only when the news webhook runs: splits the full narration script into TTS segments (title+body concat, or LLM-rewritten script when article rewrite is on). Leave empty for default behavior only.
automation.articleToScriptHint: Adds one extra LLM call per webhook before segmentation. Segmentation still runs afterward on the resulting script. If the call fails, the pipeline falls back to title+body concatenation.
automation.articleToScriptPromptPlaceholder: e.g. Shorts-friendly, 60–90 seconds spoken, calm anchor tone, Korean output.
automation.articleToScriptPromptHint: Optional. When empty, the server uses a default rewriter. Combine with your segmentation instructions for pacing.
automation.stepDesc1: Turn webhook title and body into one voiceover script (optional LLM).
automation.stepDesc2: How to cut the script into TTS segments for each scene.
automation.stepDesc3: Optional LLM lines for top and/or bottom when your selected video profile enables those headline layers.
automation.stepDesc4: Static tags and description template, or LLM-generated title, description, and tags.
automation.automationTopHeadlineHint: Adds one LLM call per webhook when enabled. The server only runs it if the selected profile has the top headline layer enabled.
automation.automationBottomHeadlineHint: Adds one LLM call per webhook when enabled. Only runs if the profile enables the bottom headline (otherwise the pipeline uses the profile name).
automation.automationBottomHeadlinePlaceholder: e.g. Short subscribe line, same language as the script.
automation.headlinePromptsNeedProfile: Select a video profile first. Headline options appear only when that profile enables top or bottom burn-in text.
automation.youtubeMetadataPromptPlaceholder: Describe how title, description, and tags should sound for this channel…
automation.youtubeMetadataPromptHint: When this box has text, it drives the one metadata LLM call instead of the three separate fields in Advanced.
automation.metadataAdvancedLegacy: Advanced: separate title, description, and tags prompts
automation.descPlaceholder: Optional text prepended to the article body in the YouTube description.
automation.metadataModeHint: LLM uses one extra call per webhook with your segmentation model. CTA and tag prefixes apply in both modes.
automation.titlePromptPlaceholder: e.g. Max 80 chars, urgent news tone, include ticker if mentioned.
automation.descPromptPlaceholder: e.g. Summarize the story for viewers; no spoilers in first line.
automation.tagsPromptPlaceholder: e.g. Finance niche, 8–12 tags, match video language.
automation.ctaPlaceholder: e.g. Subscribe for daily market updates. Links are allowed.
automation.profileShortsHint: Use a 9:16 profile for Shorts-style output.
automation.secretBody: This secret is shown only once. Store it for your automation agent.
automation.secretHeaderHint: Send the secret as header X-Webhook-Secret or Authorization: Bearer <secret>.

upload.toastFillUrlTitle: Please fill the video URL and title

generateVideo.description: Create segmented script, configure generation options, and submit video generation.
generateVideo.slideshowDescription: Turn your script into an AI video with images, subtitles, and headlines.
generateVideo.motionDescription: Transform your script into animated motion graphics with karaoke-style captions.
generateVideo.visualStylePromptPlaceholder: e.g. Blue and gold dark theme, data dashboard style...
generateVideo.visualStylePromptHint: Describe the visual look you want. Leave empty to let the AI decide.
generateVideo.pickModeTitle: How would you like to create this video?
generateVideo.toastSegmentSuccessWithVoiceover: Article converted to voiceover and segmented
generateVideo.toastSegmentFailed: Failed to segment script via LLM
generateVideo.topHeadlinePlaceholder: Leave empty to auto-generate from your script
generateVideo.bottomHeadlinePlaceholder: Leave empty to use profile label ({name})
generateVideo.toastNewsImported: Article text imported into the script
generateVideo.userMediaHint: Upload to cloud storage. Describe each file in plain language so the system can match it to the right part of the script. Pick a segment manually, or leave placement on auto so an LLM chooses from the remaining segments.
generateVideo.assetLabelPlaceholder: e.g. Donald Trump speaking at a rally in Indonesia
generateVideo.toastAssetLabelRequired: Each uploaded file needs a short description (at least 3 characters).
generateVideo.toastR2Unavailable: File uploads are not available (server storage not configured)
generateVideo.toastInvalidFileType: Use JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4, or MOV
generateVideo.toastDuplicateSegmentMedia: Only one uploaded file per segment. Adjust the segment selectors.

requests.title: Requests
requests.description: Track video generation jobs, status progression, and final outputs.
requests.autoRefreshHint: Auto refresh every 5 seconds for pending/processing jobs.

remotionPage.assetsHint: Upload images or short clips to R2. The AI will reference them as userAsset0, userAsset1, … via getInputProps. Re-render after URLs expire (~12h) or save the template so keys are stored.
remotionPage.generatingTsxHelp: LLM is writing Remotion code — usually 15–45s. Output appears in the editor below.
remotionPage.compositionHint: If the build fails with truncated JSX, shorten the prompt or close tags manually.
remotionPage.compositionPlaceholder: Paste Remotion TSX here, or generate above. Must default-export one component.
remotionPage.revisePlaceholder: What should change? (e.g. “Make the background darker blue” or “Bigger title text”)
remotionPage.renderingHelp: Remotion is bundling and encoding — often 30–120s.
remotionPage.toastInvalidFileType: Use JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4, or MOV
remotionPage.toastR2Unavailable: File uploads are not available (server storage not configured)
remotionPage.toastTsxReady: TSX ready — review below, then render.
